taskDescription: Arrange the three components of the triple response of Lewis in the correct chronological order as they appear after a firm stroke across the skin.

sequenceImages.imageDescription: Red line: capillary dilation directly along the stroke, appearing within seconds
Red flare: axon reflex dilating surrounding arterioles, spreading outward over the next minute
Raised wheal: histamine-mediated vascular permeability causing dermal oedema, developing over 3–5 minutes
